_comment: FAGE Compliance Rules — all thresholds and rule configuration for the heuristic override engine.
_comment_structuring: Structuring / smurfing detection band. Transactions where BOTH target and candidate amounts fall within [band_min, band_max] are flagged as co-occurring near-threshold structuring.
_comment_velocity: High-velocity pattern detection. Accounts with velocity_6h >= high_velocity_threshold within high_velocity_window_hours hours are flagged as exhibiting synchronized high-velocity patterns.
_comment_reserved: The following rules are RESERVED FOR v2 — they are not yet consumed by any code path in main.py or risk_engine.py. They are included here to demonstrate rule depth and allow future wiring without a config-schema change.
_comment_dormant: RESERVED v2 — not yet wired into main.py. Flag accounts that have been inactive for more than dormant_account_reactivation_days days before a new transaction appears.
_comment_corridors: RESERVED v2 — not yet wired into main.py. High-risk sender/receiver country pairs beyond simple OFAC sanctions (e.g. known hawala corridors or high-risk transit routes). Each entry is [origin_iso2, destination_iso2].
